name: SVC_PROCESS_METADATA_
description: This table contains the Process Cloud metadata of processes that are being associated to Action Plan Actions.

columns.name: PROCESS_METADATA_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: PROCESS_METADATA_NUMBER
columns.description: Auto-generated unique number with customizable format.

columns.name: PROCESS_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates if the given process is Process Cloud Process structured or dynamic.

columns.name: PROCESS_KEY
columns.description: Identifier for a unique process in Process Cloud.

columns.name: PROCESS_APPLICATION_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the display name of the process application.

columns.name: PROCESS_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the display name of the process.

columns.name: PROCESS_VERSION
columns.description: Indicates the user provided unique process version.

columns.name: PROCESS_INTERFACE_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the identifier associated to the process interface.

columns.name: PROCESS_CONNECTION_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates if the connection to Process Cloud is basic or integrated.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.
